name: Voyage Prep
description: The Chief Technical Officer of the Crux Fleet has something she needs your help with...

steps.description: Talk to the Crux Fleet crew member
Go to the Electro anomaly and complete the challenge
Reach the destination within the time limit

dialogs.content: Ho there, Traveler! How've you been? Interested in doing some work for the Crux Fleet?
The Crux Fleet...?
Eh? Oh, right! Haha, my apologies.
I'm Muzhen, Chief Technical Officer of the Alcor. I spend most of my time below deck, so it's no surprise that you're not familiar with me.
Well, Sea Drake kicked me out and made me come outside, haha.
"Move those lazy bones of yours and go get some sun, it'll do you good!," he said. So here I am, on shore, thanks to him...
Hah! Not that he'd get off the boat himself though! Why, he'd faint the moment he sets foot on dry land.
Oh...
Ah, yes. How rude of me to forget about the real business while making fun of someone else.
Well, I've got some technical preparation-related errands that you can run to help prepare for the next leg of Captain Beidou's journey.
These things are usually handled by the Captain herself. The person in command of The Crux must have the pioneering spirit to explore the unknown...
This is our rule, after all, and whoever is the boss will have to take up such duties.
Still, the Captain has priority matters she needs to attend to at the moment. Certainly not matters that should be delayed by a few small odd jobs.
So you're pushing them off to us, then?
Well, y'see, I'm a Technical Officer, not a fighter... And it's not as if the rest of the crew don't have things to do. No one's got the time to spare.
Well then. That's all for the chit-chat. Here's the skinny...
The person who ordered our next shipment wants some samples... Specifically, samples of components from some special Ruin machines.
According to the eyewitness reports this particular employer sent us, these machines... or organisms, are hidden throughout the islands of Inazuma. Very fascinating beings.
And who might this employer be...?
Oh ho? Trying to get me to spill the beans on our trade secrets huh?
Haha! Not to worry. I'd be more than happy to tell you if I knew... even though technically speaking, it'd be a capital offense.
I don't know who our employer is, anyway, so you'll have to excuse me. It's not something you should be concerned about, anyway.
So, where do we find them?
Hah! See, now you're the asking the right questions.
Trouble is that I've got no clue where they are either.

However, we've discovered strange Electro phenomena occurring in some regions of the islands. According to my observations, there is a huge gap in frequency between occurrences of such phenomena in these places compared to others across Inazuma.
I would hazard a guess that we're most likely to find good leads if we investigate these anomalous areas first.
Should you find any by-products from those phenomena, please bring them back here for me to study.
As for remuneration, don't worry, I've got you covered on that front.
Mechanical organisms?
Aye. The miners at The Chasm once dug up similar things. Word is that they're related to the disaster that happened five hundred years ago.
Whatever the case, they're an ominous bunch, wandering through the ruins as they do. Gets me scared and excited all at once...
Just thinking about one of them makes my hands itch. Wish I could pry one open and have a look inside...
It's alright if you don't understand. You're not a technician, after all.
Interesting, you say...
Well, I mean... Wouldn't you want to open one up yourself?
Not... really...?
Hmph. Alright then... I guess only a fellow technician would understand how I feel.
Do you need a hand with anything?
Do I know you?
